canonical_term: TIF Base Value and Excess Value
summary: Paired valuation concepts used to calculate TIF allocation: the redevelopment project valuation or base value and the excess value above that base in the current year.
plain_language: TIF turns one parcel value into two accounting buckets: the old/base value and the new/increment value.

facts.object: assessed valuation last certified to political subdivisions in the year prior to effective date to divide tax
for expedited review projects, Form 96-252 instructions state the base value is the assessed value last certified in the year in which the redevelopment plan is approved
current year total assessed value less redevelopment project base valuation
no excess value or TIF proceeds are available until current value again exceeds base value

relationships.note: Notice to Divide requires assessor base value and codes.
